definition: [ שְׁרָא ] verb 1. loosen . 2. abide (see Biblical Hebrew I. שׁרה ); — Pe`al Infinitive לְמִשְׁרֵא Dan 5:16 read ׳ מִשׁ also v Dan 5:12 , for ׳ מְשָׁ ( K § 40 n M 87 * and others); — Passive participle שְׁרֵא ( K § 47. Beisp. f )) Dan 2:22 plural שְׁרַיִן Dan 3:25 — 1. loosen: literal passive participle loosed Dan 3:25 (opposed to bound); figurative loosen knots, i.e. solve difficulties, Dan 5:12 ; Dan 5:16 . 2. abide (from loosening girths, loads, at encampment; compare ᵑ7 Late Hebrew [also on passive participle]), figurative Dan 2:22 ( עִם of person). Pa`el Perfect 3 masculine plural שָׁרִיו Ezra 5:2 begin (see Biblical Hebrew III. [ חָלַל ] Hiph`il 2 ), followed by infinitive Hithpa. Participle masculine plural מִשְׁתָּרַ֫יִן Dan 5:6 joints were loosened (in fear).
